messages:
maria: Quick announcement: next week we'll cutover CI to label-based runners. Old shared pool will be retired. Migration window: 2026-06-01 -> 2026-06-04.

kevin: TL;DR for engineers: update workflows using `runs-on: [self-hosted]` to one of: `runs-on: [runner:core]`, `runs-on: [runner:infra]`, or `runs-on: [runner:exp]`. See infra note for mapping.

indra: Any automation to help update repo templates?

maria: Yep. We're landing a codemod and a template PR for common repo scaffolds. Will post links tomorrow.

kevin: If you need gpu/privileged runners, file an ops ticket now — we'll reserve capacity.

infra-bot: TASK: infra will publish runner-inventory CSV and codemod repo by 2026-05-28 18:00 UTC.

maria: Plan is canary on 2026-06-01 for opt-in repos only. We'll notify maintainers via DM and post daily status in #eng at 09:15 UTC.

ops-bot: NOTICE: retention for migration logs = 90 days; audit logs will include old_vs_new_label mapping.

kevin: If you hit failures after switch, tag #eng-oncall and add `ci-migration` label to the failing PR so we can triage quickly.

indra: Thanks — we'll run codemod against SDK repos first.
